llm.summary: This skill is a Chinese K12 teacher workflow that reads and summarizes one student's learning records for renewal reports, with clear consent checks and manual sending boundaries.

dimensions.detail: It handles sensitive minor-student learning records, but that access is disclosed, scoped to the selected student and relevant fields, and proportionate to generating an evidence-based report.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact is Markdown and JSON schema/reference material only; I found no executable install hooks, remote payload retrieval, package installation, or tool spoofing behavior.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill repeatedly requires a named student alias before reading records, forbids cross-student scanning, limits parent-visible output to consented cases, and tells the teacher to send messages manually.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: It can write only confirmed stage evidence to progressEvidence[] and provides view, correction, export, pause, and deletion controls limited to its own evidence entries; it explicitly refuses student status changes, broad deletion, scheduling, and message sending.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose, data use, and outputs align: it creates stage reports and renewal talking points from lesson logs, homework followups, course package data, consent fields, and progress evidence.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install this only for a Chinese-language K12 teaching workflow where teachers are allowed to access the relevant student records. Before generating any parent-facing report, confirm the named student, check the parent communication and emotion-sharing consent fields, and keep message sending and any student-profile changes under teacher control.
llm.findings:
[SQP-3] expected: The Chinese-only renewal scripts are consistent with the broader artifact context, which declares a Chinese Mainland Chinese-language K12 deployment context; this is not evidence of hidden or unsafe behavior.
[SQP-3] expected: The stage report templates are Chinese-only, but they support the same declared Chinese teacher workflow and include consent, alias-only, and manual-send safeguards.
[SQP-3] expected: The grade-band guidance is Chinese-only, but shared platform guidance explicitly frames the library for Chinese Mainland K12 usage and says other regions require localization.
